course_title: Scaler Data Science & Machine Learning (Complete 110-Lecture Masterclass)
description: Comprehensive 110-lecture Scaler Data Science & Machine Learning program covering Python Foundations, SQL, NumPy, Pandas, Exploratory Data Analysis, Probability & Applied Statistics, Hypothesis & A/B Testing, Supervised & Unsupervised Machine Learning, Tree Ensembles, Deep Learning, NLP, Time Series, and MLOps.
learning_path_goal: Master End-to-End Data Science, Statistics, Machine Learning & Deep Learning with Scaler
cover_colors: 110 Lectures • Python • SQL • ML • Deep Learning

modules.title: Orientation, Python Programming & Problem Solving Foundations
objectives: Set up your Data Science workflow and master Python syntax, variables, control flow, and loops
Develop algorithmic thinking and structured problem-solving skills for data roles

modules.title: Python Data Structures, Functions, OOP & Time Complexity
objectives: Master Python lists, tuples, dictionaries, sets, list comprehensions, and functional programming
Apply Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), recursion, and Big-O complexity analysis in Python

modules.title: SQL & Relational Databases for Data Science
objectives: Write complex SQL queries using Joins, Aggregations, Subqueries, CTEs, and Window Functions
Design relational schemas and extract analytical insights from production databases

modules.title: NumPy, Pandas & Vectorized Data Manipulation
objectives: Perform high-performance numerical computing and matrix operations with NumPy
Clean, transform, merge, pivot, and aggregate large tabular datasets with Pandas

modules.title: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) & Data Visualization
objectives: Create compelling statistical visualizations using Matplotlib, Seaborn, and Plotly
Conduct end-to-end Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), feature engineering, and outlier treatment

modules.title: Probability Theory & Applied Statistics
objectives: Master conditional probability, Bayes theorem, random variables, and probability distributions
Apply Central Limit Theorem, sampling distributions, and confidence intervals to real datasets

modules.title: Hypothesis Testing, Experimentation (A/B Testing) & Calculus/Linear Algebra
objectives: Run Z-tests, T-tests, Chi-square tests, ANOVA, and production A/B testing experiments
Understand matrix decompositions, eigenvalues, gradients, and optimization for Machine Learning

modules.title: Supervised Machine Learning — Regression & Classification
objectives: Build and regularize Linear, Ridge, Lasso, and Logistic Regression models from scratch and in Scikit-Learn
Evaluate models with ROC-AUC, Precision-Recall, Cross-Validation, k-NN, and Naive Bayes

modules.title: Tree Ensembles, Gradient Boosting & Unsupervised Learning
objectives: Master Decision Trees, Bagging, Random Forests, XGBoost, LightGBM, and CatBoost
Apply K-Means, Hierarchical Clustering, DBSCAN, PCA, and t-SNE for dimensionality reduction

modules.title: Deep Learning, Neural Networks, Computer Vision & NLP
objectives: Train multilayer perceptrons, CNNs, and sequence models with backpropagation and modern optimizers
Build Natural Language Processing (NLP) pipelines using word embeddings, RNNs, Attention, and Transformers

modules.title: Time Series Forecasting, Recommender Systems & MLOps
objectives: Build ARIMA/SARIMA time-series models and collaborative/content-based recommendation engines
Deploy, monitor, and scale end-to-end Machine Learning pipelines in production

course_title: Scaler Academy — Complete DSA in Java, OS, DBMS, CN, Low & High Level System Design
description: Complete 170-lecture Scaler Academy Software Engineering program covering Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced Data Structures & Algorithms in Java, DBMS, Operating Systems, Computer Networks, Low-Level Design (SOLID, Design Patterns, Machine Coding Splitwise/BookMyShow/Parking Lot), and High-Level System Design.
learning_path_goal: Master DSA in Java, CS Fundamentals (DBMS, OS, CN), Low-Level Design & High-Level System Design
cover_colors: 170 Lectures • DSA • DBMS • OS • CN • LLD • HLD

modules.title: Programming Foundations, Java Basics, Arrays, Strings & OOP
objectives: Build strong logical thinking, pattern problem-solving, and Java programming fundamentals
Master 1D/2D Arrays, ArrayLists, Strings, Java Memory Management, and Object-Oriented Programming

modules.title: Intermediate DSA — Time Complexity, Arrays, Subarrays, Matrices & Bit Manipulation
objectives: Analyze asymptotic time & space complexity and solve array prefix-sum, carry-forward, and subarray problems
Manipulate 2D matrices, bitwise operators, and modular arithmetic in coding interviews

modules.title: Intermediate DSA — Sorting, Hashing, Recursion, Linked Lists, Stacks, Queues & Trees
objectives: Implement custom comparators, hashing techniques, and recursive problem-solving patterns
Build foundational Linked Lists, Stacks, Queues, and Binary Trees from scratch

modules.title: Advanced DSA — Arrays, Bit Manipulation, Modular Arithmetic, Primes, Combinatorics & Recursion
objectives: Tackle hard 1D/2D array interview problems, bit masking, GCD, prime sieves, and combinatorics
Master advanced recursion and divide-and-conquer paradigms

modules.title: Advanced DSA — Sorting, Binary Search, Two Pointers, Hashing & String Algorithms
objectives: Master Merge Sort, Quick Sort, Radix Sort, and Binary Search on arrays and answer spaces
Apply Two Pointers, Sliding Window, HashMaps, and KMP/Rabin-Karp string pattern matching

modules.title: Advanced DSA — Linked Lists, Stacks, Queues, Deques, Binary Trees, BST & LCA
objectives: Solve complex pointer manipulation problems on Linked Lists, Monotonic Stacks, and Deques
Master Binary Tree traversals, views, Binary Search Trees (BST), and Lowest Common Ancestor (LCA)

modules.title: Advanced DSA — Tries, Heaps, Greedy Algorithms & Backtracking
objectives: Implement prefix/bitwise Tries, Priority Queues/Heaps, and Greedy scheduling strategies
Master Backtracking for permutations, combinations, N-Queens, and constraint satisfaction

modules.title: Advanced DSA — Dynamic Programming (1D/2D/Knapsack/Trees) & Graph Algorithms
objectives: Master 7 sessions of Dynamic Programming: memoization, tabulation, knapsack, strings, and DP on trees
Implement BFS, DFS, Topological Sort, Dijkstra, Bellman-Ford, MST, and Disjoint Set Union (DSU) on Graphs

modules.title: CS Fundamentals — Database Management Systems (DBMS) & SQL Internals
objectives: Master the Relational Model, SQL CRUD, Joins, Aggregations, Subqueries, and Views
Understand ACID Transactions, Concurrency Control, B+ Tree Indexing, and Query Optimization

modules.title: CS Fundamentals — Operating Systems (OS), Concurrency & Computer Networks (CN)
objectives: Understand OS processes, CPU scheduling, threads, executors, mutexes, semaphores, deadlocks, and virtual memory
Master Computer Networks: OSI/TCP-IP layers, DNS, HTTP, TCP vs UDP, and Socket Programming

modules.title: Low Level Design (LLD) — OOP Principles, SOLID, Design Patterns, UML & Schema Design
objectives: Apply Encapsulation, Inheritance, Polymorphism, and all 5 SOLID Design Principles in production code
Master Creational (Singleton, Builder, Prototype, Factory), Structural (Adapter, Facade, Flyweight), and Behavioral (Strategy, Observer) patterns, UML, and Schema Design

modules.title: Low Level Design (LLD) — Machine Coding Case Studies (Pen, Tic-Tac-Toe, Parking Lot, BookMyShow, Splitwise)
objectives: Design and machine-code extensible object models for a Pen, Tic-Tac-Toe, and Snake & Ladders
Architect and code production-grade Parking Lot, BookMyShow (concurrency & seat locks), and Splitwise CLI applications

modules.title: High Level System Design (HLD) — Distributed Systems, Microservices & Real-World Architectures
objectives: Master Consistent Hashing, Caching, CAP Theorem, SQL vs NoSQL, Master-Slave/Multi-Master, Zookeeper, Kafka, Elasticsearch, and S3/QuadTrees
Design end-to-end architectures for Typeahead, Messaging, Uber, Hotstar Live Streaming, and IRCTC

course_title: Gaurav Sen — AI Engineering 2026 (Vectors, LLM Internals, RAG, Agents & MCP)
description: Gaurav Sen's 2026 AI Engineering course covering Vector Embeddings, Milvus Vector DB, LLM Internals, Attention Is All You Need, KV Caching, PagedAttention, Mixture of Experts (MoE), FlashAttention, Quantization, Speculative Decoding, Chain-of-Thought Reasoning, Context Engineering, AI Agents, and MCP.
learning_path_goal: Master Production AI Engineering: Vector DBs, LLM Internals, Inference Optimization, Agents & MCP
cover_colors: Vectors • LLM Internals • FlashAttention • AI Agents • MCP

modules.title: Course Introduction & Practical AI Engineering Use Cases
objectives: Understand the role of an AI Engineer and the production AI system lifecycle
Define latency, cost, accuracy, and reliability requirements for real-world AI applications

modules.title: Vector Embeddings, Semantic Space & Vector Databases (Milvus Case Study)
objectives: Understand how dense vector embeddings are constructed using bi-encoders and BERT
Master vector compression, quantization, HNSW/IVF indexing, search execution flow, and the Milvus SIGMOD architecture

modules.title: Large Language Models (LLMs), Tokenization, Generation & RAG
objectives: Understand autoregressive LLM pre-training, tokenization schemes, and decoding parameters
Architect Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and evaluate LLM system trade-offs

modules.title: LLM Internals — Positional Embeddings, Self-Attention & KV Caching
objectives: Deep dive into Rotary/Sinusoidal Positional Embeddings and the Transformer 'Attention Is All You Need' architecture
Optimize autoregressive decoding throughput and memory footprint using KV Caching

modules.title: Core LLM Inference Optimizations — PagedAttention, Mixture of Experts (MoE) & FlashAttention
objectives: Eliminate KV-cache memory fragmentation using vLLM's PagedAttention
Scale model capacity and GPU IO efficiency with Sparsely-Gated Mixture of Experts (MoE) and FlashAttention

modules.title: LLM Trade-offs — Quantization, Sparse Attention, Distillation & Speculative Decoding
objectives: Compress LLMs with post-training quantization (INT8/INT4/AWQ) and Sparse Attention patterns
Accelerate inference using Small Language Model (SLM) knowledge distillation and Speculative Decoding

modules.title: Reasoning Models — Chain of Thought, Tool Calling, RLHF & Inference-Time Scaling
objectives: Enable multi-step reasoning via Chain-of-Thought (CoT), Tree-of-Thought, and RLHF alignment
Equip LLMs with external tools and test-time compute scaling for complex reasoning tasks

modules.title: Transformer Architecture Deep Dive — Masked & Multi-Head Attention
objectives: Trace tensor shapes and causal masking inside Masked Self-Attention layers
Understand parallel subspace projections in Multi-Head Attention

modules.title: Context Engineering, Autonomous AI Agents & Model Context Protocol (MCP)
objectives: Design production Context Engineering pipelines for long-context LLMs
Build autonomous AI Agents and standardize tool/data integrations using the Model Context Protocol (MCP)

course_title: Gaurav Sen — Low Level Design (LLD) & Machine Coding Masterclass 2026
description: Gaurav Sen's complete 81-lecture Low Level Design (LLD) & Machine Coding course covering SOLID Principles, Design Patterns (Prototype, Iterator, Builder, Singleton, Chain of Responsibility, Memento, Proxy, Flyweight, State, Factory, Command, Strategy, Pub-Sub), and 4 end-to-end Machine Coding projects: Game Engine, Splitwise Payment App, Multi-threaded In-Memory Cache, Asynchronous Event Bus, and Distributed Rate Limiter.
learning_path_goal: Master SOLID Principles, Gang-of-Four Design Patterns & Production Machine Coding Interviews
cover_colors: 81 Lectures • SOLID • Design Patterns • Machine Coding

modules.title: Introduction to Low Level Design, Requirements & Package Structuring
objectives: Understand what Low Level Design (LLD) is and how to translate product requirements into domain objects
Structure clean APIs, packages, and modular boundaries in object-oriented systems

modules.title: Building a Turn-Based Game Engine — Base Classes, Main Loop & Debugging
objectives: Design extensible parent/base classes and game loops for a turn-based board game engine
Debug object state transitions and board representations

modules.title: Single Responsibility Principle (SRP) & Automated Unit Testing
objectives: Decouple AI player logic from core Game rules using the Single Responsibility Principle
Write deterministic unit tests to verify game engine invariants

modules.title: Stateless AI Move Exploration & Prototype Design Pattern
objectives: Implement lookahead AI move exploration without mutating live game state
Apply the Prototype Design Pattern for clean state cloning

modules.title: Don't Repeat Yourself (DRY) & Iterator Design Pattern
objectives: Eliminate duplicate traversal logic across board rules using the DRY principle
Implement the Iterator Design Pattern for uniform cell and rule iteration

modules.title: Open-Closed Principle (OCP), Rule Engine & Builder Design Pattern
objectives: Add fork-detection and extensible rule evaluation using a generic Rule Engine and Open-Closed Principle
Construct complex immutable configurations cleanly with the Builder Design Pattern

modules.title: Liskov Substitution Principle (LSP) & Object Encapsulation
objectives: Support timed games and subtype polymorphism while honoring the Liskov Substitution Principle
Encapsulate nested state and behavior inside cohesive domain objects

modules.title: Interface Segregation (ISP), Dependency Inversion (DIP), Singleton & Chain of Responsibility
objectives: Support multiple AI personalities with Singleton, Null Object, and Chain of Responsibility patterns
Apply Interface Segregation and Dependency Inversion principles to decouple high-level policy from details

modules.title: Memory & Code Optimization — Memento, Proxy & Flyweight Design Patterns
objectives: Implement Undo/Redo move history using the Memento Design Pattern
Optimize memory footprint and deep nested loops using Proxy and Flyweight patterns

modules.title: Test-Driven Changes — State & Factory Design Patterns
objectives: Manage complex game lifecycle transitions with the State Design Pattern
Centralize object creation and test-driven refactoring using the Factory Design Pattern

modules.title: Command, Strategy & Pub-Sub Patterns + Object Pools
objectives: Build event-driven email notifications using Command, Strategy, and Publisher-Subscriber patterns
Compare Inheritance vs Composition and optimize object reuse with Object Pools

modules.title: Case Study 1 — Payment Tracking App (Splitwise) Design & Machine Coding
objectives: Define entities, states, APIs, and the simplified minimum-cash-flow balance settlement algorithm
Code the complete Splitwise service skeleton, balance engine, and unit test suite

modules.title: Case Study 2 — Machine Coding a High-Performance In-Memory Cache
objectives: Design a concurrent cache supporting Read-Your-Writes consistency, thread assignment, and fast LRU/LFU eviction
Machine-code asynchronous GET/SET operations, hot loading, and request collapsing

modules.title: Case Study 3 — Machine Coding an Asynchronous Event Bus
objectives: Architect a multi-threaded Event Bus with Keyed Executors, Pull & Push subscribers, and extensible retry algorithms
Machine-code event bus data structures, wrapper classes, and concurrency tests

modules.title: Case Study 4 — Machine Coding a Distributed Rate Limiter
objectives: Design a clean Rate Limiter with Models, Controllers, ThreadPools, and Dependency Inversion
Implement the Sliding Window rate-limiting algorithm with backpressure and stale-entry cleanup

description: Gaurav Sen's flagship 161-lecture System Design Simplified (HLD) program covering 30 modules across 4 pillars: (1) Scaling from 1 to 1M Users, (2) Distributed Systems Deep Dives (Databases, Consistency, Caching, Networks, Replication, Security, Observability, Paxos, Rate Limiting, Trade-offs), (3) 10 Real-World HLD Architectures (Gmail, Tinder, WhatsApp, Chess, Hotstar, Google Docs, Uber, Google Maps, WhatsApp Calling, Recommendation Engine), and (4) 8 Whitepaper Analyses (Facebook Memcached, Google Zanzibar, Gorilla & Monarch, Meta TAO, Google Dremel, Kafka, Spark, Milvus).
learning_path_goal: Master High-Level System Design, Distributed Systems Internals & Foundational Engineering Whitepapers
cover_colors: 161 Lectures • 30 Modules • HLD Case Studies & Whitepapers

course_title: Namaste AI — Inside the Mind of AI & AI-Native Software Engineer (Seasons 1 & 2)
description: Complete Namaste AI masterclass across Season 1 (Inside the Mind of AI: Evolution of AI, Autoregressive LLMs, Tokenization, Embeddings, Neural Networks, Pre-training, SFT/RLHF & Reasoning) and Season 2 (AI-Native Software Engineer: Building, Architecting, Designing, Securing & Deploying Production Full-Stack Apps with AI).
learning_path_goal: Master LLM Foundations & Build Production Full-Stack Applications as an AI-Native Software Engineer
cover_colors: 24 Episodes • Inside the Mind of AI & AI-Native SWE

modules.title: Season 1: Inside the Mind of AI — Evolution of AI & How LLMs Predict
objectives: Trace the evolution of Artificial Intelligence from symbolic rules to modern foundation models
Understand autoregressive next-token prediction and how ChatGPT generates responses

modules.title: Season 1: Tokenization, Semantic Vector Spaces & The Computational Brain of Machines
objectives: Understand how BPE tokenization converts raw text into the secret numerical language of LLMs
Explore high-dimensional embeddings, semantic meaning representation, and neural network computation

modules.title: Season 1: Pre-Training, Fine-Tuning (SFT & RLHF) & Reasoning Models
objectives: Understand how foundation models sharpen their weights during pre-training and backpropagation
Transform a base model into an aligned AI Assistant via SFT/RLHF and evaluate AI reasoning capabilities

modules.title: Season 2: AI-Native Software Engineer — Ideation, PRDs, System Architecture & API/DB Design
objectives: Brainstorm product features and generate comprehensive Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) using AI
Produce production-ready System Design Architecture, Database Schemas, and API specifications with AI

modules.title: Season 2: AI-Native Full-Stack Development — UI/UX, Scaffolding, Auth, Onboarding & RBAC
objectives: Design modern UI/UX systems and scaffold full-stack application architectures using AI workflows
Implement Authentication, User Onboarding, Transactional Email flows, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)

modules.title: Season 2: Shipping to Production — Deployment, Custom Domains, Dashboards & Media Pipelines
objectives: Deploy full-stack AI-built applications to production infrastructure with custom domain configuration
Build User Dashboards, Event/Task Management, Invites/RSVP workflows, and Photo Upload/Gallery pipelines

course_key: Keerti Purswani Agentic AI System Design Course 2026
course_title: Keerti Purswani (Educosys) — Agentic AI System Design Course 2026
description: Keerti Purswani's (Educosys) 2026 live cohort on Agentic AI System Design covering AST/Lexical/Hybrid/Agentic RAG, RAG Evaluation Metrics, Context Engineering, Agent Memory, HNSW, Claude Code Architecture & Implementation, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent Skills, Long-Running Tasks, Safety, Semantic Caching, Langfuse, Sharding, and LLMOps.
learning_path_goal: Architect, Evaluate & Scale Production Agentic AI Systems, Claude Code Clones, MCP & Multi-Tenant RAG
cover_colors: Agentic AI System Design 2026 • RAG • MCP • Claude Code • LLMOps

modules.title: Foundations of AI Agents, AST/Lexical/Hybrid/Agentic RAG & Evaluation Metrics
objectives: Understand AI Agent architectures and implement AST, Lexical, Semantic, Hybrid, and Agentic RAG pipelines
Evaluate RAG retrieval and generation quality using ranking metrics, precision/recall, and faithfulness

modules.title: RAG Evaluation Comparison, Context Engineering & Agentic Memory Systems
objectives: Compare RAG architectures systematically across latency, cost, and retrieval accuracy
Design Context Engineering pipelines and short-term/long-term/episodic Memory in Agentic Applications

modules.title: Claude Code Capstone Architecture, HNSW Indexing, MCP, Agent Skills & Guardrails
objectives: Deconstruct the high-level architecture of Claude Code and HNSW vector indexing
Build extensible agents with Model Context Protocol (MCP), modular Skills, Safety Guardrails, and Long-Running Task orchestration

modules.title: Scaling Agentic Systems — Reindexing, Semantic Caching, Langfuse, Sharding & Multi-Tenancy
objectives: Implement end-to-end Claude Code design, zero-downtime vector reindexing, and Semantic Caching
Scale multi-tenant RAG systems with Sharding, Langfuse observability, and distributed tracing

modules.title: Agentic AI System Design Interviews, LLMOps, Token Budgeting & Capstone Demos
objectives: Master Agentic AI System Design interview questions, LLMOps production pipelines, and Token Budgeting
Review production capstone architectures and end-to-end working code walkthroughs

course_title: Arpit Bhayani — Complete System Design Masterclass (Beginner + Advanced Cohorts)
description: Arpit Bhayani's complete 52-lecture System Design Masterclass combining the 36-lecture Beginner Cohort (Databases, Sharding, Caching, Kafka, Load Balancers, Bloom Filters, Consistent Hashing & 11 Real-World HLD Case Studies) and the 16-lecture Advanced Cohort (Storage Engines, Distributed ID Generators, Social Networks, High-Throughput Systems, Information Retrieval, Ad-hoc & Algorithmic System Design).
learning_path_goal: Master Asli Engineering System Design from Core Building Blocks to Storage Engine Internals & High-Throughput Systems
cover_colors: 52 Lectures • Beginner + Advanced System Design Masterclass

modules.title: System Design Foundations, Evaluation & Relational Database Internals
objectives: Understand how to approach system design problems and quantitatively evaluate architectural quality
Master Relational Databases and ACID Transaction Isolation Levels

modules.title: Scaling Databases, Sharding, Partitioning, NoSQL & Multi-Layer Caching
objectives: Scale databases vertically and horizontally using read replicas, sharding, and partitioning
Choose between SQL and NoSQL databases and populate/scale caches across multiple system tiers

modules.title: Message Brokers, Kafka, Real-Time Pub/Sub, Load Balancers & Auto-Recovery
objectives: Architect asynchronous pipelines with Message Queues, Kafka Streams, and Real-time Pub/Sub
Configure L4/L7 Load Balancers, Circuit Breakers, Data Redundancy, and Leader Election for failover

modules.title: Network Protocols, Blob Storage (S3), Bloom Filters, Consistent Hashing & Big Data
objectives: Compare client-server communication protocols and design object storage on S3
Apply Bloom Filters, Consistent Hashing rings, and Big Data processing tools

modules.title: HLD Case Studies I — E-Commerce Catalog, API Rate Limiter, Notifications, Abuse Filter & Tinder Feed
objectives: Design high-scale E-Commerce Product Listings, Distributed API Rate Limiters, and Notification engines
Architect Real-time Abuse Detection systems and low-latency Tinder Recommendation Feeds

modules.title: HLD Case Studies II — Twitter Trends, URL Shortener, Pastebin, Fraud Detection, RecSys & Web Crawler
objectives: Design real-time Twitter Trends pipelines, URL Shorteners, and GitHub Gists/Pastebin storage
Architect Fraud Detection systems, Recommendation Engines, and polite Planet-Scale Web Crawlers

modules.title: Advanced Cohort I — Foundational System Design, SQL/NoSQL Internals, Distributed Systems & ID Generators
objectives: Deep dive into advanced foundational trade-offs, relational B-Tree internals, and NoSQL storage models
Master distributed systems coordination and high-throughput Distributed ID Generators (Snowflake/UUID)

modules.title: Advanced Cohort II — Building Social Networks, Storage Engines Internals & High-Throughput Systems
objectives: Design end-to-end Social Network graphs, feeds, and fan-out architectures
Examine Storage Engine internals (LSM Trees, WAL, Compaction) and engineer ultra-high-throughput systems

modules.title: Advanced Cohort III — Information Retrieval Systems, Ad-hoc Design & Algorithmic System Design
objectives: Build inverted indexes and scoring pipelines for large-scale Information Retrieval & Search systems
Solve unscripted Ad-hoc System Design challenges and Algorithmic System Design problems

course_key: Sanket Advanced System Design HLD LLD 2026
course_title: Sanket Singh — Advanced System Design (HLD & LLD) Masterclass 2026
description: Sanket Singh's complete and updated 506-lecture Advanced System Design masterclass covering Low-Level Design (SOLID Principles, Creational/Structural/Behavioral Design Patterns, Object-Oriented Architecture, ATM LLD, Parking Lot, BookMyShow, Chess, Splitwise, Stock Exchange), High-Level Design (Scalability, Load Balancers, Caching, Databases, Sharding, Message Brokers, URL Shortener, Uber, Newsfeed), Distributed Systems Internals (Consistency Models, CAP/PACELC, LSM Trees, Lamport/Vector Clocks, Spanner TrueTime, RAFT & PAXOS Consensus, 2PC & Sagas, CQRS), Production Case Studies (Elasticsearch, Cassandra, InfluxDB, Netflix, WhatsApp, Debezium CDC, Rate Limiters, Zerodha), and Infrastructure Engineering (FastAPI, Redis, Networking, Infra Scripts). Includes 146 supplementary PDF study guides and architectural notes.
learning_path_goal: Master Low-Level Design (LLD), Design Patterns, High-Level Design (HLD), and Scalable Distributed Systems Architecture with Sanket Singh
cover_colors: 506 Lectures + 146 Study Notes • Advanced HLD & LLD 2026

modules.title: SOLID Principles & Object-Oriented Design Foundations
objectives: Master Single Responsibility (SRP), Open-Closed (OCP), and Liskov Substitution (LSP) principles
Apply Interface Segregation (ISP) and Dependency Inversion (DIP) with real-world refactoring
Design maintainable Low-Level systems avoiding anti-patterns and monster classes

modules.title: Creational & Behavioral Design Patterns
objectives: Implement Factory Method, Abstract Factory, Prototype, and Builder creational patterns in production code
Master Iterator, Repository, Adapter, Chain of Responsibility, and Command patterns
Build decoupled event-driven systems using the Observer design pattern and PubSub messaging

modules.title: Machine Coding Case Studies I (ATM, Parking Lot, BookMyShow)
objectives: Design an interactive ATM Machine with State Pattern handling PIN verification and cash dispensing
Build complete Parking Lot Low-Level Design with multi-floor spot allocation and ticket pricing
Architect BookMyShow ticketing engine with concurrency guards and criteria filtering

modules.title: Machine Coding Case Studies II & Concurrency
objectives: Implement Chess Machine Coding interview problem with move validation and board representations
Design Splitwise expense sharing, simplification algorithms, and balance settlements
Architect High-Throughput Stock Exchange engine with Spring Boot, locks, threads, and concurrency primitives

modules.title: High-Level System Design (HLD) Foundations & Scaling
objectives: Master core High-Level Design building blocks: Client-Server, Scalability, Availability, and Latency vs Throughput
Understand Relational vs NoSQL trade-offs, Database Transactions, ACID, and Isolation Levels at scale
Deploy and scale infrastructure using AWS EC2, ELB, Nginx load balancers, and Apache Kafka message queues

modules.title: High-Level Design (HLD) Large-Scale Architecture Case Studies
objectives: Design URL Shortener handling 100M+ writes and billions of redirects with custom base62 hashing
Architect Uber ride-hailing platform with geospatial indexing (QuadTree/H3) and driver matching
Build distributed Job Scheduling platforms, Hotel Reservation systems, and Live NewsFeed timeline generation

modules.title: Distributed Systems Internals: Consistency, Clocks & Consensus
objectives: Master Consistency models, CAP Theorem, PACELC theorem, and distributed trade-offs
Design Key-Value Stores, Caching layers, and database storage engines with LSM Trees
Deep dive into Distributed Clocks (Lamport, Vector Clocks, Google Spanner TrueTime) and Consensus (RAFT & PAXOS)

modules.title: Distributed Transactions, Sagas & CQRS
objectives: Resolve distributed data mutations using Two-Phase Commit (2PC) and understand its limitations
Implement Orchestration and Choreography Saga patterns for resilient microservices workflows
Design Command Query Responsibility Segregation (CQRS) and event-driven data views

modules.title: Production Case Studies: Storage, Streaming & Event Systems
objectives: Architect full-text search with Elasticsearch inverted indexes, TF-IDF, and distributed shards
Design real-time collaborative documents (Google Docs), Cassandra databases, and Time-Series DBs (InfluxDB)
Build Netflix video streaming, WhatsApp/Chat messaging, Debezium CDC pipelines, and Zerodha stock broker mock interview

modules.title: System Engineering, Testing, Networking & Microservices
objectives: Master Concurrent Programming with multi-threading, semaphores, and thread pools
Apply automated testing principles, unit testing strategies, and system design networking protocols
Build high-speed microservices using FastAPI, Redis caching internals, and automated infrastructure monitoring scripts

course_title: Sanket Singh — Complete Spring Boot, Microservices & Distributed Systems Masterclass
description: Sanket Singh's comprehensive 255-lecture backend engineering masterclass covering Java Foundations & OOP, Computer Networks, AWS Cloud Infrastructure, Docker & CI/CD with GitHub Actions, Spring Boot 3 Core, Reactive Programming with WebFlux, Observability (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki), Spring AI & RAG, Message Queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ), Distributed Transactions (2PC, SAGA, CQRS, gRPC), Kubernetes Orchestration (Pods, HPA, PV/PVC), and Production Projects (Distributed Wallet App, Uber Geospatial Service, Airbnb Idempotency Engine, Quora ElasticSearch Service, Stock Exchange Trading Engine, and Netflix Eureka Microservices). Includes 37 supplementary PDF study notes and architectural guides.
learning_path_goal: Master Production Java, Spring Boot 3, Distributed Systems, Microservices, and Cloud Native Architecture with Sanket Singh
cover_colors: 255 Lectures + 37 Study Notes • Spring Boot & Microservices 🌱

modules.title: Java Programming Foundations, OOP, Collections & Multithreading
objectives: Master Java syntax, operators, loops, control structures, and the Java Memory Model
Implement Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), interfaces, abstract classes, and exception handling
Apply Java Collections Framework, Generics, Lambdas, Streams, and multithreading fundamentals

modules.title: Computer Networks & Internet Protocols (TCP, UDP, HTTP, DNS, WebSockets)
objectives: Understand OSI and TCP/IP networking models, IP addressing, subnetting, and socket programming
Master Domain Name System (DNS), HTTP/1.1 vs HTTP/2 vs HTTP/3, and SSL/TLS handshakes
Implement real-time bidirectional communication using WebSockets and long-polling techniques

modules.title: Cloud Infrastructure & AWS Fundamentals (IAM, S3, EC2, VPC, Redshift, RDS)
objectives: Architect scalable cloud infrastructure using Amazon Web Services (AWS)
Configure AWS IAM policies, security groups, VPC networking, and S3 object storage
Deploy relational databases with Amazon RDS and analyze big data with Amazon Redshift

modules.title: Docker Containerization & CI/CD Pipelines with GitHub Actions
objectives: Containerize full-stack Java applications using multi-stage Dockerfiles and Docker Compose
Optimize Docker layer caching, resource limits, and container networking for microservices
Automate testing, container building, and deployment using GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows

modules.title: Spring Boot 3 Core, Observability, Spring AI & Reactive WebFlux
objectives: Master Spring Boot 3 dependency injection, application configuration, and custom annotations
Implement full-stack observability with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, and Loki
Build modern AI-driven backends using Spring AI, Prompt Engineering, RAG, and Spring WebFlux

modules.title: Distributed Transactions, 2PC, SAGA Pattern, CQRS & gRPC
objectives: Solve distributed data consistency challenges across microservices architectures
Implement Two-Phase Commit (2PC) and SAGA Patterns (Orchestration vs Choreography)
Design high-performance low-latency service-to-service communication using gRPC and Protocol Buffers

modules.title: Real-World Distributed Projects (Wallet App & Uber Geospatial Service)
objectives: Build a production Distributed Digital Wallet with ACID transactional guarantees and SAGA flows
Architect an Uber-style ride matching backend with Geohashing, Geospatial indexes, and WebSockets
Implement high-throughput real-time location tracking and driver dispatch algorithms

modules.title: Kubernetes Container Orchestration (Pods, Services, HPA, PV/PVC & K9s)
objectives: Deploy and orchestrate enterprise microservices on production Kubernetes clusters
Configure Pods, Deployments, ReplicaSets, Services, Ingress, and Namespaces with kubectl & K9s
Implement autoscaling with Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA) and manage Persistent Volumes (PV/PVC)

modules.title: Database Replication, Sharding, Debezium CDC & Airbnb Project
objectives: Master database replication topologies, consistent hashing, sharding, and partition tolerance
Implement Change Data Capture (CDC) streaming using Debezium and Apache Kafka
Architect an Airbnb booking engine with strict Idempotency Keys and distributed lock managers

modules.title: Advanced Concurrency, Stock Exchange Engine & Netflix Eureka
objectives: Master low-level Java concurrency, locks, atomic variables, and lock-free data structures
Build an ultra-low-latency Stock Exchange matching engine with multi-threading and order books
Implement Microservices Service Discovery, client-side load balancing, and Netflix Eureka registries

course_key: Sanket Singh Complete AI Engineer Bootcamp 2026
course_title: Sanket Singh — Complete AI Engineer Bootcamp 2026 (FastAPI, LLMs, Agents & RAG)
description: Comprehensive 110-lecture AI Engineering bootcamp covering full-stack AI development with FastAPI, Large Language Model evaluation and reasoning, LangChain agents, Streamlit dashboards, Vector Databases, and enterprise RAG architectures.
learning_path_goal: Master Full-Stack AI Engineering from FastAPI backends to Autonomous Multi-Agent Workflows and RAG systems
cover_colors: 110 Lectures + 38 Study Notes • AI Engineer Bootcamp 2026

modules.title: Python Backend & FastAPI Framework for AI Applications
objectives: Master Python full-stack architecture, asynchronous programming, and REST APIs with FastAPI
Build scalable microservice endpoints for model serving and payload handling

modules.title: LLM Foundations, Datasets, Evaluation & Reasoning Limitations
objectives: Explore Large Language Model architectures, tokenization, context windows, and prompting
Evaluate LLM benchmark datasets (GSM8k) and address reasoning and hallucination limits

modules.title: LangChain, Autonomous Agents & Interactive Streamlit UIs
objectives: Build production AI interfaces using Streamlit with real-time streaming
Implement tool-calling autonomous agents, function execution, and agentic workflows

modules.title: RAG Pipelines, Vector Databases & Asynchronous Task Queues
objectives: Deploy Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) using dense embeddings and vector databases
Integrate asynchronous background workers, message queues, and production deployment

course_title: Sanket Singh — System Design 2.0 (Complete Low-Level & High-Level Masterclass 2026)
description: Comprehensive 507-lecture flagship System Design 2.0 masterclass covering complete Low-Level Design (SOLID, 23 Design Patterns, Real-World Implementations) and High-Level Design (Scalability, Distributed Caching, Sharding, CAP Theorem, CQRS, AWS Glue ETL, and Real-World HLD Case Studies).
learning_path_goal: Achieve Staff/Principal level mastery of Object-Oriented LLD, Clean Code, and Distributed Systems HLD Architecture with Sanket Singh
cover_colors: 507 Lectures + 146 Study Notes • Flagship HLD & LLD Masterclass

modules.title: SOLID Principles, OOP Foundations & Code Smells
objectives: Master Single Responsibility, Open-Closed, Liskov Substitution, Interface Segregation, and Dependency Inversion
Identify and refactor anti-patterns and code smells in production codebases

modules.title: Creational & Behavioral Design Patterns (Factory, State, Observer)
objectives: Implement Factory Method, Abstract Factory, and Builder design patterns
Master State and Observer patterns through complete Low-Level Design implementations

modules.title: Structural Design Patterns & Low-Level Design Projects
objectives: Master Adapter, Decorator, Facade, Composite, Strategy, and Command patterns
Build production-grade Low-Level Design systems with clean architecture

modules.title: HLD Building Blocks: Networking, Scalability, Load Balancers & Caching
objectives: Understand High-Level Design building blocks: Client-Server, DNS, Latency, and Throughput
Design scalable multi-tier architectures with Load Balancers, Reverse Proxies, and Redis Caching

modules.title: Cloud Computing, Infrastructure as Code & AWS Deployment (EC2)
objectives: Provision and secure cloud infrastructure on Amazon Web Services (AWS EC2)
Deploy and monitor containerized distributed backends on production virtual machines

modules.title: Distributed Data Stores, Replication, Sharding & CAP Theorem
objectives: Master relational vs NoSQL storage, ACID transactions, and BASE consistency
Implement consistent hashing, database replication, and horizontal sharding

modules.title: Microservices Architecture, Event-Driven Systems & CQRS / AWS Glue
objectives: Design event-driven microservices using CQRS and asynchronous message brokers
Implement ETL data pipelines using AWS Glue and serverless big data architectures

modules.title: End-to-End Large Scale System Design Case Studies
objectives: Architect large-scale production systems: URL Shortener, LeetCode, Top-K, and Rate Limiters
Conduct mock system design interviews and analyze trade-offs in high-concurrency systems

course_title: Codebasics — Data Engineering Bootcamp 1.0 (Python, SQL, AWS, Spark, Snowflake & Airflow)
description: Codebasics complete 291-lecture Data Engineering Bootcamp covering Python, Advanced SQL, Data Modeling, AWS Glue ETL, Apache Spark/PySpark optimization, Snowflake Data Lakehouse, Apache Airflow orchestration, Kafka streaming, and production capstone analytics projects.
learning_path_goal: Master end-to-end Enterprise Data Engineering from SQL & PySpark to AWS, Snowflake, and Real-Time Streaming Systems
cover_colors: 291 Lectures + 224 Study Files • Data Engineering Bootcamp 1.0

modules.title: Python Programming & SQL for Data Engineers
objectives: Master Python data manipulation, scripting, and modular architecture for data pipelines
Write advanced SQL queries, window functions, CTEs, and optimize query execution plans

modules.title: Data Warehousing, Data Modeling & ETL with AWS Glue
objectives: Design dimensional schemas (Star & Snowflake), fact tables, and slowly changing dimensions (SCD)
Build serverless ETL data transformation pipelines using AWS Glue and Amazon Athena

modules.title: Apache Spark, PySpark & Distributed Big Data Processing
objectives: Master PySpark DataFrames, Spark SQL, RDDs, transformations, and actions
Solve data skew, memory management, shuffle partitioning, and optimize big data jobs

modules.title: Modern Data Lakehouse (Snowflake / Delta Lake) & Access Control
objectives: Architect cloud Data Lakehouses with ACID transaction support using Delta Lake and Snowflake
Implement role-based access control (RBAC), data governance, stages, and external tables

modules.title: Workflow Orchestration (Airflow) & Streaming with Kafka
objectives: Orchestrate complex DAG workflows and task dependencies using Apache Airflow
Build real-time event streaming pipelines with Apache Kafka and Spark Streaming

modules.title: End-to-End Enterprise Data Engineering Capstone Projects
objectives: Build end-to-end data analytics pipelines: Supply Chain, Financial Analytics, and Medical Data Extraction
Deploy and monitor production pipelines with automated data quality validations

course_key: Sanket Singh Top Coding Interview Problem
course_title: Sanket Singh — Top Coding Interview Problems Masterclass (DSA, DP, Graphs & Core CS)
description: Comprehensive 454-lecture algorithmic interview preparation masterclass covering Big-O analysis, Master Theorem, Advanced Data Structures, Dynamic Programming, Graph Algorithms (Kahn's, Dijkstra), SQL Transactions & Isolation Levels, and Core Computer Networks.
learning_path_goal: Master FAANG/Tier-1 Coding Interview Problem Solving in Algorithms, Dynamic Programming, Graphs & Core Computer Science
cover_colors: 454 Comprehensive Problem Walkthroughs • DSA & Core CS Masterclass

modules.title: Algorithm Analysis, Big-O Complexity & Recursion Foundations
objectives: Analyze time and space complexity with hardware constraints, Master Theorem, and recurrence relations
Master deep recursion, divide-and-conquer, backtracking, and state-space tree exploration

modules.title: Data Structures Problem Solving: Arrays, Strings, Trees & Heaps
objectives: Master two-pointer techniques, sliding windows, monotonic stacks, and binary trees
Implement priority queues, heaps, and tree traversals for interview problem sets

modules.title: Dynamic Programming Mastery: 1D, 2D, Knapsack & Tree DP
objectives: Master top-down memoization, bottom-up tabulation, and state transition formulation
Solve classic and advanced DP problems: Knapsack, Longest Common Subsequence, and Matrix Chain

modules.title: Graph Algorithms, Shortest Paths, Topological Sort & Disjoint Sets
objectives: Implement Breadth-First Search (BFS), Depth-First Search (DFS), and Kahn's Topological Sort
Apply Dijkstra, Bellman-Ford, Kruskal, Prim, and Disjoint Set Union (DSU) algorithms

modules.title: Core CS for Interviews: SQL, Transactions, Networks & OS Internals
objectives: Master complex SQL queries, JOINs, aggregations, and ACID transaction isolation levels
Understand computer networking internals: IP addressing, TCP handshakes, and socket communication

course_title: Harkirat Singh — 100xDevs Combined Mega Bootcamp (Full-Stack, DevOps, Web3 & AI/ML)
description: Comprehensive 313-lecture 100xDevs mega bootcamp covering Full-Stack Web Development (TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js), Advanced Backend & Databases (PostgreSQL, Prisma, Redis), Data Structures & Algorithms, DevOps & Kubernetes, Web3 & Solana Smart Contracts in Rust, and modern AI/ML Engineering (LLM Evals, Offline RL & Agentic Memory).
learning_path_goal: Achieve 100x Engineer Mastery across Full-Stack, High-Throughput DevOps, Web3 Decentralized Protocols, and Production AI/ML Engineering with Harkirat Singh
cover_colors: 313 Complete Lectures + 12 Study Guides • Full-Stack, DevOps, Web3 & AI/ML

modules.title: Full-Stack Foundations, TypeScript, React & Node.js Backend
objectives: Master JavaScript/TypeScript, React 19, Next.js, and server-side rendering (SSR)
Build scalable REST and GraphQL backend services with Express and Node.js

modules.title: Advanced Backend Engineering, Databases, ORMs & Caching
objectives: Master PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Prisma ORM, and database connection pooling
Implement Redis caching, rate limiting, pub/sub queues, and real-time WebSockets

modules.title: Data Structures, Algorithms & Competitive Programming
objectives: Solve algorithmic interview problems in Arrays, Trees, Dynamic Programming, and Graphs
Analyze time and space complexity with rigorous Big-O benchmarks

modules.title: DevOps, Containerization, Kubernetes & Production CI/CD
objectives: Containerize microservices with Docker and orchestrate them on Kubernetes (EKS/GKE)
Automate deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions, Prometheus, and Grafana monitoring

modules.title: Web3, Blockchain Architecture, Solana & Smart Contracts in Rust
objectives: Master decentralized systems, cryptographic hashing, and transaction consensus
Develop on-chain Solana programs using Rust, Anchor framework, and liquidity pools

modules.title: AI & Machine Learning Engineering (LLMs, Offline RL, Harness & Evals)
objectives: Build and evaluate state-of-the-art LLM architectures, fine-tuning, and offline RL environments
Implement memory architectures, evaluation harnesses, and enterprise agentic systems

course_key: Azure Data Bricks by Sameer Sir Durgasoft
course_title: Sameer Sir (DurgaSoft) — Complete Azure Databricks (ADB) & Delta Lake Masterclass
description: Master Azure Databricks (ADB) end-to-end with Sameer Sir from DurgaSoft. Complete 40-session hands-on masterclass covering distributed cluster architectures, worker autoscaling, Spark DataFrames, DBUtils widgets, cloud storage connectors (ADLS Gen2, Azure Blob, SQL DB, Synapse Analytics), Azure Key Vault secrets, multi-format schema enforcement (Parquet, ORC, JSON, CSV, XML, Excel), Spark Structured Streaming, and deep Delta Lake internals (ACID transactions, time travel, Z-Ordering, OPTIMIZE, and VACUUM).
learning_path_goal: Master Azure Databricks (ADB), Apache Spark, Cloud Storage Connectors, Structured Streaming, and Delta Lake Lakehouse Architectures with Sameer Sir (DurgaSoft)
cover_colors: 40 Complete Sessions • Apache Spark, ADLS Gen2 & Delta Lake

modules.title: Azure Databricks Architecture, Workspaces & Cluster Operations
objectives: Master the Azure Databricks control plane, data plane, DBFS, and distributed execution engine
Provision interactive and automated job compute clusters, driver and worker node sizing, and notebook magic commands

modules.title: Apache Spark DataFrames, Spark SQL & Databricks Utilities (DBUtils)
objectives: Build, transform, and optimize Apache Spark DataFrames and execute high-performance Spark SQL queries
Automate notebook workflows using Databricks Utilities (DBUtils), file system commands, and dynamic interactive widgets

modules.title: Azure Cloud Storage & Enterprise Data Source Integrations
objectives: Connect Azure Databricks securely to Azure Blob Storage, ADLS Gen2, Azure SQL DB, and Azure Synapse Analytics
Configure production OAuth 2.0, service principals, SAS tokens, and secret management with Azure Key Vaults

modules.title: Multi-Format Big Data Ingestion & Schema Enforcement
objectives: Ingest, parse, and enforce StructType schemas on CSV, JSON, ORC, Parquet, XML, and Excel data files
Handle nested records, multi-line JSON, custom delimiters, and partitioned cloud data lakes at scale

modules.title: Modern Lakehouse Architecture, Structured Streaming & Delta Lake Mastery
objectives: Understand the evolution from traditional data warehouses to modern lakehouse architectures and batch ETL loading
Implement real-time streaming with Spark Structured Streaming, Delta Lake table creation, ACID transactions, time travel, and OPTIMIZE/VACUUM compaction

course_title: Vizuara AI — Master LLM Inference Engineering 2026
description: High-performance LLM Inference Engineering masterclass by Dr. Sreedath Panat. Deep dive into the Vizuara Inference Book, Hardware GPU Labs, KV Cache optimization, Attention variants (MHA, MQA, GQA, Latent, Mamba), Flash Attention 1/2/3 mathematical derivations, vLLM step execution internals, AWQ/FP8 quantization, Speculative Decoding, and the InferTutor Arena Capstone.
learning_path_goal: Master High-Performance LLM Inference Optimization, vLLM & GPU Kernel Acceleration

modules.title: Inference Foundations, Hardware Labs & KV Cache Dynamics
objectives: Master the physics and memory bandwidth bottlenecks of Large Language Model inference
Understand the good and evil of Key-Value (KV) Cache, memory footprints, and GPU memory layouts

modules.title: Attention Variants & Sequence Architectures
objectives: Deep dive into Multi-Head Attention (MHA), Multi-Query Attention (MQA), and Grouped-Query Attention (GQA)
Explore Latent Attention, Sparse Attention, Sliding Window Attention, and State Space Models (Mamba)

modules.title: Flash Attention 1, 2, 3 & GPU Kernel Optimization
objectives: Understand IO-awareness, SRAM tiling, and FlashAttention 1, 2, and 3 mathematical derivations
Benchmark FlashAttention kernels on cloud GPU clusters (RunPod / H100)

modules.title: Production Inference Engines: vLLM Anatomy & PagedAttention
objectives: Dissect the exact execution step of vLLM: scheduler, sequence groups, and GPU memory manager
Master PagedAttention algorithms eliminating KV cache memory fragmentation

modules.title: Quantization, Speculative Decoding & Capstone Project
objectives: Apply post-training quantization (AWQ, GPTQ, FP8) and weight-activation scaling
Implement Speculative Decoding with draft models and complete the InferTutor Arena Capstone

course_key: Vizuara AI - SLM Small Language Models Engineering 2026
course_title: Vizuara AI — SLM Small Language Models Engineering 2026
description: Comprehensive 35-lecture Small Language Models (SLM) bootcamp by Dr. Sreedath Panat. Build custom edge-ready SLMs from scratch: Transformer tensor implementations, Multi-Head & Self Attention, RoPE positional encodings, BPE tokenizers, pre-training dynamics & perplexity interpretation, LoRA fine-tuning, RLHF alignment, KV cache acceleration, and live coding a 12.3M parameter model from the ground up.
learning_path_goal: Master Small Language Model (SLM) Architecture, Pre-Training, Fine-Tuning & Edge Deployment

modules.title: SLM Foundations, Research Workflows & Parameter Capacity
objectives: Explore Small Language Model (SLM) paradigms, computational budgets, and high-density knowledge storage
Set up modern research workflows using autonomous coding agents

modules.title: Transformer Architecture & Mathematical Foundations
objectives: Trace the evolution from RNNs to Transformers and master Multi-Head Self-Attention using raw PyTorch tensors
Develop geometric intuition for QKV projections, causal masking, GPT parameter calculations, and Rotary Embeddings (RoPE)

modules.title: Data Curation, Cleaning & Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) from Scratch
objectives: Curate, deduplicate, and clean pre-training datasets for specialized domain SLMs
Train custom Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) tokenizers from scratch and map token IDs to embedding vectors

modules.title: Pre-Training Dynamics, Perplexity & Sampling Strategies
objectives: Execute SLM pre-training loops, monitor cross-entropy loss, and intuitively interpret perplexity scores
Master advanced sampling heuristics: Temperature, Top-K, Top-P, Min-P, and Repetition Penalties

modules.title: Fine-Tuning with LoRA, RLHF & Preference Alignment
objectives: Implement Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) for parameter-efficient fine-tuning on consumer hardware
Collect preference datasets and apply Reinforcement Learning from Human/AI Feedback (RLHF & RLAIF)

modules.title: Inference Acceleration: KV Cache, GQA, Speculative Decoding & PagedAttention
objectives: Optimize inference with Grouped-Query Attention (GQA), KV Cache reuse, and speculative drafting
Implement continuous batching and PagedAttention for on-device and edge cloud deployment

modules.title: Live Coding a 12.3M SLM from Scratch & Final Capstone
objectives: Live code a complete 12.3 Million parameter Small Language Model from blank file to inference
Benchmark prompt prefill and parallel decoding, delivering the final SLM Capstone Project

course_title: Vizuara AI — Production AI Agents Bootcamp 2026
description: Flagship 10-day hands-on Production AI Agents bootcamp by Dr. Sreedath Panat (vizuara.ai/courses/course_20005503). Master the ReAct framework, Hugging Face Smolagents, Multi-Agent systems, Agentic RAG with LlamaIndex, cyclic state graphs with LangGraph, CrewAI multi-agent teams, n8n automations, the comprehensive AI Agents Book (64MB), and 5 production capstone projects including the Jan 2026 ML-DL industrial capstone repository.

Implement the ReAct (Reasoning + Acting) framework from scratch with raw LLM prompts

modules.title: Agent Workflows & Smolagents Implementation
objectives: Architect deterministic vs autonomous agent workflows and decision trees
Build lightweight, production-grade text and vision agents using Hugging Face Smolagents

modules.title: Multi-Agent Systems & Agentic RAG with LlamaIndex
objectives: Design multi-agent collaborative networks with role specialization and supervisor routing
Implement Agentic RAG pipelines using LlamaIndex for dynamic document routing and synthesis

modules.title: Stateful Agent Graphs: LangGraph & CrewAI Orchestration
objectives: Build cyclical state machines, human-in-the-loop approvals, and vision agents using LangGraph
Orchestrate hierarchical enterprise agent teams using CrewAI with custom tools and memory

modules.title: Enterprise Automation with n8n & Industrial Capstone Projects
objectives: Integrate autonomous agents into business systems via n8n automation workflows
Deploy 5 production capstones: Customer Support Agent, Research Pipeline, and ML-DL Industrial Projects

course_key: Grow Data Skills Complete Data Engineering With Azure
course_title: Grow Data Skills — Complete Data Engineering with Azure, PySpark, Databricks & Snowflake
description: Comprehensive 77-lecture enterprise masterclass in modern Data Engineering and Cloud Analytics by Grow Data Skills. Covers production SQL, Hadoop ecosystem, Apache Hive, Apache Kafka real-time streaming, MongoDB and Cassandra NoSQL, Apache Spark and PySpark data processing, Azure Databricks lakehouse architecture, Apache Airflow orchestration, Snowflake data warehousing, GCP BigQuery, full Azure Cloud Stack (ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Synapse Analytics), real-world industrial capstone projects, and comprehensive resume and interview strategies.
learning_path_goal: Master Modern Cloud Data Engineering with Azure, PySpark, Databricks, Snowflake & Kafka

modules.title: Data Engineering Foundations & Production SQL
objectives: Master relational database concepts, schema architecture, and SQL query fundamentals
Write complex filtering, analytical window functions, subqueries, CTEs, and query optimization

modules.title: Big Data Distributed Systems & Ecosystem (Hadoop, Hive, Kafka & NoSQL)
objectives: Learn distributed storage concepts with Hadoop HDFS and data warehousing with Apache Hive
Implement real-time event streaming with Apache Kafka and distributed NoSQL with MongoDB and Cassandra

modules.title: Apache Spark & PySpark Large-Scale Data Processing
objectives: Understand Spark core architecture, RDDs, transformations, and memory execution engine
Master PySpark DataFrames, structured transformations, partitioning, and performance tuning

modules.title: Modern Lakehouse Architecture, Databricks & Workflow Orchestration
objectives: Build modern lakehouse architectures using Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, and ACID transactions
Orchestrate complex multi-stage data pipelines using Apache Airflow DAGs and scheduling

modules.title: Enterprise Cloud Data Warehousing (Snowflake & GCP BigQuery)
objectives: Design dimensional schemas, star/snowflake architectures, and modern cloud data warehouses
Deep dive into Snowflake micro-partitions, Time Travel, zero-copy cloning, and GCP BigQuery

modules.title: Azure Cloud Data Engineering Stack (ADLS, ADF & Synapse Analytics)
objectives: Architect enterprise cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure using ADLS Gen2
Develop scalable ETL pipelines with Azure Data Factory (ADF) and analyze big data with Synapse

modules.title: Industrial End-to-End Capstone Projects & Career Acceleration
objectives: Implement production-grade end-to-end data engineering projects from ingestion to consumption
Prepare high-impact resumes, optimize LinkedIn profiles, and master technical interview strategies

course_title: Namaste Node.js — Complete Backend Architecture, DevTinder & Cloud Deployment (Seasons 1, 2 & 3)
description: Master enterprise backend engineering from scratch to production with Akshay Saini's flagship 44-episode masterclass. Season 1 explores Node.js core internals (V8 engine, libuv, thread pool, event loop phases, CommonJS/ES modules, and streams). Season 2 walks through end-to-end production backend development building DevTinder (Express, REST APIs, Mongoose schemas, JWT cookies, bcrypt encryption, compound indexing, and full frontend UI integration). Season 3 guides cloud deployment and production scaling (AWS EC2, NGINX reverse proxies, custom SSL domains, Amazon SES email delivery, cron automation, Razorpay payments, and real-time WebSockets with Socket.io).
learning_path_goal: Master Enterprise Node.js, Systems Architecture & Production Deployment

modules.module_title: Season 1: Node.js Architecture, V8 & libuv Internals
outcomes: Understand V8 JavaScript engine, libuv async I/O, event loop phases and thread pool internals
Master CommonJS vs ES module systems, require mechanics, and Node core APIs

modules.module_title: Season 2: DevTinder Backend Architecture, Express & MongoDB
outcomes: Design scalable RESTful APIs with Express, routing handlers, custom middlewares and error handling
Implement MongoDB with Mongoose schemas, JWT cookie authentication, bcrypt hashing, and compound indexing

modules.module_title: Season 2: DevTinder Full-Stack UI Integration
outcomes: Connect DevTinder backend to frontend client application with Redux state management
Build interactive user feed cards, swipe matching actions, profile management and reviews

modules.module_title: Season 3: Cloud Deployment, DevOps, Security & Real-Time Production
outcomes: Deploy Node.js to AWS EC2 with NGINX reverse proxy, PM2 process management and SSL domains
Implement Amazon SES transactional email, automated cron jobs, Razorpay payments and Socket.io WebSockets

course_title: NeetCode — System Design for Beginners & Distributed Interview Masterclass
category: High Level System Design & Distributed Systems
description: Complete 30-lecture System Design masterclass by NeetCode covering fundamental building blocks and high-level architectural interview case studies. Part 1 covers computer architecture, design requirements, networking protocols (TCP/UDP, DNS, HTTP, WebSockets), API design, caching strategies, CDNs, proxies, load balancing, consistent hashing, SQL vs NoSQL, database replication/sharding, CAP theorem, object storage, and message queues. Part 2 walks through real-world architectural case studies: Rate Limiter, TinyURL, Twitter feed architecture, Discord real-time chat, YouTube video streaming pipeline, Google Drive file sync, Google Maps geospatial routing, distributed key-value store, and distributed message broker.
learning_path_goal: Master Scalable Distributed Systems & High Level Architecture

modules.module_title: System Design Fundamentals & Networking Protocols
outcomes: Understand computer architecture bottlenecks, tiered systems, and non-functional requirements
Master transport layer protocols, DNS resolution, HTTP/HTTPS and real-time WebSockets

modules.module_title: API Architecture, Caching & Distributed Traffic
outcomes: Design scalable REST/gRPC APIs and implement caching with write-through and eviction strategies
Architect content delivery networks (CDNs), reverse proxies, load balancers, and consistent hashing

modules.module_title: Data Storage, Replication, Partitioning & Messaging
outcomes: Compare SQL vs NoSQL databases, evaluate CAP theorem trade-offs, and master sharding/replication
Utilize distributed object storage and event-driven message queue architectures

modules.module_title: Real-World Distributed Systems & Interview Case Studies
outcomes: Master the 4-step system design interview framework across production scale architectures
Design Rate Limiter, TinyURL, Twitter, Discord, YouTube, Google Drive, Google Maps, Key-Value Store, and Kafka

course_title: Azure Data Engineering 2026 — Complete Big Data, ADF, PySpark, Synapse & Loan Finance Capstone
category: Cloud Data Engineering & Big Data Systems
description: Master end-to-end Cloud Data Engineering on Microsoft Azure with Bhaskar Jogi's comprehensive 125-lecture masterclass. Covers Big Data foundations, Hadoop ecosystem, HDFS architecture and CLI, MapReduce internals, Linux for data engineers, Apache Hive data warehousing, Apache Spark and PySpark structured transformations, memory management, Azure Data Factory (ADF) pipelines, triggers, data flows, Azure Synapse Analytics, Delta Lake, file formats (Parquet, ORC, Avro), data compression, schema evolution, and an exhaustive real-world industrial Banking & Loan Finance Analytics capstone project with dataset cleansing, scoring algorithms, and Agile/Scrum delivery.
learning_path_goal: Master Azure Big Data Infrastructure, PySpark, ADF & Financial Capstone

modules.module_title: Big Data Foundations, Linux & Hadoop HDFS Internals
outcomes: Understand big data ecosystem, OLTP vs DWH vs Data Lake, and role of data engineers
Master essential Linux CLI administration and Hadoop HDFS distributed storage architecture

modules.module_title: Distributed Computing with MapReduce Internals
outcomes: Understand distributed computation, MapReduce execution lifecycle, and reducers/combiners
Apply MapReduce patterns to build data extraction and transformation pipelines

modules.module_title: Apache Spark Core Architecture, RDDs & Python Basics
outcomes: Master Apache Spark internals, resilient distributed datasets (RDDs), Python basics, and execution DAGs
Perform transformations, joins, broadcast operations, partitioning, and caching

modules.module_title: PySpark DataFrames, Spark SQL & Performance Optimization
outcomes: Build structured ETL pipelines using PySpark DataFrames, Spark SQL, and managed/unmanaged tables
Handle bad records, nested schemas, schema enforcement, and Spark session optimization

modules.module_title: Enterprise Data Warehousing & Dimensional Modeling (Amazon Project)
outcomes: Design dimensional models, star/snowflake schemas, fact/dimension tables, and SCD types
Implement enterprise data warehouse architecture modeled on Amazon real-time e-commerce data

modules.module_title: Advanced Spark Internals, AQE, Salting & Memory Management
outcomes: Deep dive into Spark query execution plans, adaptive query execution (AQE), and join strategies
Solve partition skew with salting techniques and optimize dynamic/static executor memory allocation

modules.module_title: Enterprise Big Data File Formats, Storage & Compression
outcomes: Master columnar storage (Parquet, ORC), row-based (Avro), compression algorithms, and schema evolution
Optimize I/O bandwidth and serialization performance across large distributed clusters

modules.module_title: Industrial Banking & Loan Finance Analytics Real-Time Capstone Project
outcomes: Execute an enterprise Agile/Scrum data project ingesting multi-source loan and customer datasets
Cleanse bad records, engineer feature pipelines, calculate loan risk scores, and build analytical data marts

modules.module_title: Apache Hive Distributed Data Warehousing & SQL
outcomes: Execute SQL queries on massive distributed datasets using Apache Hive warehousing engine
Manage Hive metastore, internal/external tables, partitioning, and query execution

course_title: DevOps with Multi-Cloud & AI — Complete 174-Day Enterprise Masterclass (AWS, Azure, GCP, K8s & AI-Ops)
description: Exhaustive 174-day enterprise-grade masterclass in DevOps and Multi-Cloud Architecture by industry veteran Veerababu Sir (Naresh IT). Comprehensive hands-on mastery across Linux system administration, Git and GitHub source control, AWS Cloud Services (EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, ECS, EKS), Microsoft Azure Cloud, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), containerization with Docker, enterprise container orchestration with Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform and Ansible, continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) with Jenkins and GitHub Actions, Prometheus and Grafana monitoring, DevSecOps, and modern AI-Ops workflows.
learning_path_goal: Master Multi-Cloud Architecture, Kubernetes, IaC, CI/CD & AI-Ops

modules.module_title: Multi-Cloud Fundamentals & Linux/Git System Administration
outcomes: Master Linux operating system architecture, user permissions, and bash automation scripts
Implement Git/GitHub version control workflows, branching strategies, and repository management

modules.module_title: Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud Architecture & Infrastructure
outcomes: Architect scalable enterprise cloud environments with AWS EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, and Route 53
Configure relational databases with Amazon RDS, serverless Lambda, and security firewalls

modules.module_title: Containerization with Docker & Multi-Container Architectures
outcomes: Build, optimize, and secure container images with multi-stage Dockerfiles and registries
Orchestrate multi-container applications with Docker Compose and software-defined networks

modules.module_title: Enterprise Kubernetes (K8s) Cluster Orchestration & Management
outcomes: Deploy, scale, and manage resilient microservice architectures using Kubernetes Pods, Deployments & Services
Master ConfigMaps, Secrets, Ingress controllers, Persistent Volumes, and Helm package management

modules.module_title: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform & Ansible Automation
outcomes: Provision reproducible multi-cloud infrastructure declaratively with Terraform HCL and remote state
Automate configuration management, package installation, and server provisioning with Ansible playbooks

modules.module_title: Continuous Integration & CI/CD Pipelines (Jenkins & GitHub Actions)
outcomes: Build automated CI/CD deployment pipelines using Jenkins declarative pipelines and GitHub Actions
Integrate Maven build automation, SonarQube code quality gates, and automated container pushes

modules.module_title: Multi-Cloud (Azure & GCP), Observability (Prometheus/Grafana) & AI-Ops
outcomes: Manage hybrid workloads across Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) environments
Implement full-stack observability with Prometheus and Grafana dashboards, alerting, and AI-Ops automation
